gloss: in rapid succession; one after another

definitions.gloss: in rapid succession; one after another; in a row
definitions.explanation: Describes events or actions occurring one right after the other without pause.

examples.japanese: {続|つづ}けざまに{質問|しつもん}された。
examples.english: I was asked questions in rapid succession.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}が{続|つづ}けざまに{起|お}きた。
{彼|かれ}は{続|つづ}けざまに{三杯|さんばい}もビールを{飲|の}んだ。
examples.english: He drank three beers in a row.

notes:
Almost always used with the particle に as {続|つづ}けざまに. Emphasizes the lack of interval between events. Derived from {続|つづ}ける (to continue) + さま (manner).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {続|つづ}けざまに{起|お}こる: to happen in succession
- {続|つづ}けざまに{打|う}つ: to strike repeatedly
- {続|つづ}けざまに{飲|の}む: to drink one after another

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {立|た}て{続|つづ}けに: in succession — very close synonym, equally common
- {次々|つぎつぎ}と: one after another — broader, can have longer gaps between events
- {矢継|やつ}ぎ{早|ばや}に: in rapid-fire succession — emphasizes speed
